faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for the AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 is 20th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for various posts including Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Technical Support-III (MSW), Project Nurse-III, Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician), and SRF Ayurveda.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts advertised by AIIMS Patna?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for specific categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from MBBS and BAMS to B.Sc./M.Sc. Nursing, and graduate/postgraduate degrees in Social Work or Sociology, or DMLT/MLT.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I (Lab Technician) post is Rs. 18000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves an Interview, Written Test, and Skill Test, depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Patna, which is www.aiimspatna.edu.in.
